note: Nine student profiles, three per track. expected_missing was written by hand from the goal wording and any chip edits, against the curated track definition in data/rules/goal_skills.json (target skills plus their prerequisites). These cases therefore measure profile interpretation and gap arithmetic, not whether the curated curriculum itself is right. 'known_skills' and 'excluded_skills' are chip edits a student makes in the UI.
